messages:
maya: Heads up — ap-southeast-1 dedicated pool is at ~100% GPU allocation, queue backlog increasing, and we've started routing overflow to hosted fallback (09:03 UTC). Long-context jobs are dominating slots.

sam: Any idea what the spike is from? sudden traffic or a job?

maya: Looks like nightly fine-tuning jobs kicked off earlier. One job got mis-tagged and requested 64 GPUs instead of 4. log snippet: `job-id=ft-8842 started=2025-12-11T08:40:12Z gpus=64`

lee: Ops dashboard: autoscaler tried to provision nodes but hit EC2 launch-quotas on the account. Yesterday's release increased desired count but account quota is still 0->64 blocked.

anita: We should immediately apply queue backpressure for non-prod to buy time. Rate-limit and requeue low-priority jobs.

julian: I've pushed a small routing patch to send low-priority and best-effort to hosted. Command I used:

```
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.redwood/api/v1/routes" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"region":"ap-southeast-1","policy":"fallback-hosted","filter":"priority:low"}'
```

ops-bot: Automated: started fallback routing, 14% of traffic shifted to hosted (policy=fallback-hosted). Incident ticket created INC-2025-348.

maya: Cost heads-up: hosted fallback multiplies unit cost. If sustained, estimate ~USD 3.8k/hr extra. Flagging finance/eng-sre.

sam: Immediate action plan: 1) kill ft-8842, 2) pause non-prod nightlies, 3) submit quota increase request to AWS, 4) tighten per-job GPU caps.

maya: I terminated ft-8842 and paused other scheduled runs. Backlog dropped ~60% in 6m.

lee: Quota request submitted to AWS (case 1234567). Support ETA ~4-6 hours per response.

julian: Thinking about fallback-to-region option — we can shift low-priority APAC traffic to us-west-2 as a canary. Tradeoff: higher latency for APAC but cheaper than hosted in some cases.

anita: Let's canary 30% APAC->usw2 for low-priority only, keep high-priority on hosted/dedicated. I'll update the routing policy and monitoring alert thresholds.

julian: Canary applied. Monitoring: throughput stabilized, backlog dropping further. We see a cost spike but 95p latency for high-priority remains within SLO.

maya: Filing post-incident note and TODOs: - permanent fix: ensure autoscaler has quota guardrails and alert if quota=0 - enforce per-job GPU caps in job scheduler - add pre-deploy test to detect runaway batch job configs - add cost alarm for sustained hosted fallback > 30m.

ops-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Archived draft created: "apac-dedicated-overflow-1748001234". Reaction: :white_check_mark:.

infra-oncall: small follow-up — add a feature flag to allow global region reroute via console (for rapid manual canary). Filing as RFC item.

maya: Agree. I'll include in the postmortem. Thanks all for the quick responses :pray:
